name: RezzCraft pull up a chair
description:
[Bedrock & Java] RezzCraft - Friendly Survival SMP | Land Claims, Player Shops, Daily Quests

Looking for a long-term survival server where your base stays safe, your progress lasts, and people actually say hi back?

RezzCraft is a small, friendly Vanilla+ SMP running since 2021. Phone, console, PC or Java: everyone plays in the same world. Our rank ladder is earned by playing, and the store is cosmetics and convenience.

What we offer:

- Land claims with a golden shovel, so your base stays yours

- Bounty Board: daily quests, rare bounties, questlines, hunter levels and trophies you can place

- Reward Tracker: type /rewards to see everything you can earn and how close you are

- 9 earned ranks plus Prestige, with more homes, warps and earned-only cosmetics

- Player shops, an auction house and a server shop to earn your first money

- mcMMO skills that level up as you mine, fight, farm and fish

- Saturday fishing derbies, vote crates and vote parties

- Stargates and a live web map

- A starter kit with iron armor, and you keep your items if you die in your first 2 hours

- Menus built for phones and controllers on Bedrock

New here? Type /rtp to find land, then /sethome. A friend invited you? Type /refer [their name] in your first 48 hours and you both get rewards.

Bedrock: bedrock.rezzcraft.us (port 19132)

Java: mc.rezzcraft.us

Discord: discord.gg/ZhuBYvDWTC
